outcomeHistory already skips events whose result is refused, so supersession can express a repair without any edit or deletion.

Making event_id deterministic from (issue, state) is out of scope because outcomeHistory records a duplicate event_id as a problem, so collapsing a re-post would invalidate the ledger it is meant to fix.

The wedge issue #2847 describes has exactly two problem shapes, both artefacts of the read-back race: the same event_id posted twice, and the state already reached re-posted under a new event_id. Every other replay problem is a real gap in the record and repair must refuse it.
